name: ANSI/IEEE fused switch symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for fused switch, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The fused-switch form keeps a fuse protective element associated with a switching path. Read the switch and fuse ratings independently, then follow the device tag to the complete assembly and replacement fuse schedule.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Do not interpret the fuse current as the switch's complete operational rating.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A combined fused-switch form is different from a bare fuse symbol and from a circuit breaker.
